message: `destroy_tagged` cannot remove the tag 'coin': the named entity 'Gold' has it.
notes: named entities are part of the scene and cannot be destroyed; `destroy_tagged` removes spawned entities
help: give the spawned entities a tag of their own, for example `tag: "coin_spawned";` in their prefab, and destroy that one
